elementarySymmetric.Description:
Description

i1 : n=5;
i2 : R=QQ[x_1..x_n];
i3 : f=(product gens R)*(sum gens R);
i4 : elementarySymmetric f

o4 = e e
      1 5

o4 : QQ[x ..x , e ..e ]
         1   5   1   5

This function should work up to a size of 15 variables in the base ring.

elementarySymmetric(PolynomialRing).Description:
Description

i1 : n=5;
i2 : R=QQ[x_1..x_n];
i3 : elementarySymmetric R

o3 = map (QQ[x ..x , e ..e ], R, {x , x , x , x , x })
              1   5   1   5        1   2   3   4   5

o3 : RingMap QQ[x ..x , e ..e ] <-- R
                 1   5   1   5

This function should work up to a size of 15 variables in the base ring

SymmetricPolynomials.Description:
Description

This package uses an explicit description of the Groebner basis of the ideal of obvious relations in this algebra based on:

Grayson, Stillmann - Computations in the intersection theory of flag varieties, preprint, 2009

Sturmfels - Algorithms in Invariant Theory, Springer Verlag, Vienna, 1993
